title: Valuation Model (light contract)
description: Written by the valuation agent (Phase 2). The MODEL CHOICE and every assumption are agent judgment: each assumption is {value, rationale, basis}. Math must be produced by a cited runtime script in data/compute/, not mental arithmetic.

name.description: e.g. excess_return, dcf, nav_ffo, ddm, sotp, or a hybrid

rationale.description: Why this model fits this company/sector.

module_reference.description: Sector module section that guided the choice, if any.

margin_of_safety.description: Signed fraction: 1 - price / fair_value.base (e.g. 0.292 or -0.299). Prefer writing BOTH this and margin_of_safety_pct from the compute script.

margin_of_safety_pct.description: Signed percent points: 100 * (1 - price / fair_value.base) (e.g. 29.2 or -29.9). NEVER store a 0-1 fraction here. Primary MoS uses base FV; disclose vs probability_weighted if they differ materially.

decision_usefulness.description: high|medium|low — set when (bull-bear)/base > 100% or bear < 0.4*base. When low, do not present probability_weighted FV as a precise target.

posture.description: One sentence: assumption stack leans conservative|neutral|aggressive overall.

scenario_probabilities.description: Prefer per-leg {value,rationale,basis} for bear/base/bull, or bare floats. risk_bridge mirror must be bare floats only.

probability_method.description: How scenario masses were sized; required when weights match a common template (e.g. 30/45/25) so the mass is not a silent default.

terminal_consistency.description: Optional but expected when model uses Gordon/exit/residual terminal value: method, wacc_minus_g (or ke_minus_g), reinvestment/payout identity, tv_share_of_ev_base, and response if TV share is high.

roic_identity.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 2.8.0 when valuation exists (Python gate; not schema required[]). Same-script owner-earnings ROIC on the DCF's NOPAT/tax/lease/WACC stack, dual column residual-claim FCFF vs residual-income EV, g=0 counterfactual, legal exit when mid-cycle ROIC ≤ WACC, cheap_claim. applies:false with not_applicable_reason for banks/REITs/pre-profit growth. Example numbers are illustrative round fakes — do not copy.

mid_cycle_construction.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 2.13.0 when applies:true (Python gate). window_kind ttc_cycle|multi_year_avg|last_year|peak_year|insufficient_window; years_used year list or {start,end}; print_vs_midcycle ≥20 chars. above_wacc/franchise_mos license only ttc_cycle|multi_year_avg with ≥2 years. Example numbers are illustrative — do not copy.

multi_method_reconciliation.description: Required when a material SOTP/exit-multiple/peer cross-check is run: primary_fv_for_decision, cross_check_fv, delta_pct, why_primary_wins, what_would_flip_primary. If |SOTP−DCF|/primary > 40%, set path_reopened + what_changed or gap_rationale why the gap is real — then reopen the independent volume path if it is a skill miss.

street_bind.description: REQUIRED when registry/street_estimates.json exists (harness >= 2.7.0). On >= 2.28.0 Street FY+1 is the default Y1 start (street_baseline; |delta|>0.05 FAIL). independent_y1 needs a resolved independence_gate. On 2.18-2.27 Street was required Y1. On 2.7-2.17 Street was calibration after an independent stack. delta_pct = (base − street) / street. street must match street_estimates FY+1 when numeric.

street.description: Must match street_estimates FY+1 revenue when that value is numeric, unless response=street_unusable.

base.description: Model FY+1 revenue (same units as street). Default start is Street FY+1 on >= 2.28.0.

intra_year.description: Optional same-period quarter paths vs a typed company box (harness >= 2.18.0).

street_hooks.description: REQUIRED when registry/street_estimates.json exists. On >= 2.28.0 street_baseline consumes Street as used_as:fy1_baseline; independent_y1 may calibrate/reject. On 2.18-2.27 used_as:fy1_baseline required. On 2.7-2.17 used_as:calibration_check; path-copy forbidden. Not all noted_only.

conservatism_dials.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 2.7.0 when valuation exists. Keys volume_vs_guide, gaap_om_vs_guide, sbc_in_fcff, wacc_vs_buildup; applies_in base | bear_only | none. Omitting the array is silent stacking (FAIL). ≥3 in base requires stacking_justification.

stacking_justification.description: Required when ≥3 conservatism_dials apply in base. Silent stacking of volume + GAAP OM + SBC-as-cash + high WACC into base is FAIL-quality.

fcff_identity.description: Owner-earnings identity (harness >= 2.18.0). Never subtract SBC from after-SBC GAAP NOPAT.

discounting_convention.description: Named mid_year | year_end. Disclosure required; mid_year is not mandated.

research_brief_hooks.description: Optional when research_brief exists: map open must_answer_questions to used_as or unanswered_widens_range.

assumptions.description: Every key assumption (discount rate, growth path, margins, multiples, terminal value, probabilities).

basis.description: Source, data, or reasoning the value rests on.

compute_script.description: Path to the runtime script under data/compute/ that produced the numbers.

overrides_applied.description: Latest-quarter evidence the valuation agent chose to apply (see latest_quarter.json evidence_log).

filing_deep_dive_hooks.description: REQUIRED when registry/filing_deep_dive.json exists. How footnotes / strategy_arc / management_scorecard changed assumptions — or explicit rejects.

operating_path_hooks.description: REQUIRED when registry/operating_path_brief.json exists (harness >= 2.6.0). How the 1d brief changed growth/OM assumptions — used_as with old/new or rejected. noted_only only for immaterial slices; all-noted_only FAILs.

market_context_hooks.description: REQUIRED when registry/market_context.json exists. How listing/region intensity, accounting regime, local cost-of-capital flags, and ownership/control changed assumptions — or explicit rejects / noted_only no-ops. For intensity=low, a single noted_only entry is enough. Never paste region-module reference ranges as mandates without use/reject reason.

from.description: Path into market_context.json or region module theme (e.g. cost_of_capital_flags.use_local_rf, ownership.control_type, accounting_regime.basis).

reverse_engineering.description: What the current price implies vs own assumptions; flag if implied > bull case.

sensitivity.description: REQUIRED. Base-case FV grid over the two most judgment-dependent assumptions (e.g. discount rate x terminal profitability), so readers can see how much of the verdict is dial choice. Produced by the compute script.
